title: Fluoride-baseline: detectors, sampling plans and controls for the Fluc/CrcB fluoride channel census across archaeal genomes
description: Three calibrated equivalog profile HMMs (Fluc/CrcB, CLC-F, FAcD), their calibration records, phylogenetically balanced sampling plans over GTDB r226, census tables, and a self-testing control suite supporting the manuscript on the detection of the Fluc/CrcB fluoride channel across 1,259 archaeal genomes.
